title: 第4章 菜鸟警花
content_zh:
退入教室的赵铁柱，狰狞的面孔上透着几分惊魂未定的恐惧，额头上密密麻麻的都是冷汗。

他谨慎的透过窗户打量着外面的情况，见那些警察没有靠近，狙击手也无法再锁定他，这才狼狈的喘着粗气，松懈下来。

感受到背后凶徒的身躯，不断地微微颤抖，秦朗心里愈发淡定起来。一个怕死的凶徒，比起一个亡命之徒，要容易对付许多。

“妈的，这些狗屁警察居然想要我死，老子偏要活着。”赵铁柱神神叨叨地自语了几声，突然拿刀拍拍秦朗的头，“小子，给我蹲下，要是敢乱动的话，老子马上给你放血。”

秦朗心头一喜，对方肯放开对他的挟持，对他来说，可是好事。

所以他马上点点头，在对方松开胳膊以后，他没有任何的抗拒，立刻就乖乖蹲下了身子。

如果这时候赵铁柱细心观察的话，就会发现一直处于半窒息状态的秦朗，并没有在脖子获得自由以后，大口的呼吸，而是始终保持着一成不变的呼吸规律，腹部轻微的膨胀收缩。

只可惜，赵铁柱看不到这一点。秦朗的顺从，在他的眼里成了懦弱和胆小，而秦朗腹部的胀缩，在他眼里则成了簌簌发抖的恐惧。

一个弱不禁风，又胆小如鼠的高中生，根本不足以造成任何威胁，赵铁柱哪里还会担心。

他提着染血的刀，焦虑不安的走来走去，不时的凑到窗户边朝外面看上一眼，然后骂骂咧咧，一会儿骂警察，一会儿骂梅语嫣。

“铁柱哥，我真没有想害你的想法，就当我求你了，你放过那个学生好不好，或者，我去换那个学生，我给你当人质！”窗户外面突然传来了梅语嫣透过喇叭放大的声音。

“放屁，臭婊子，你跟那些警察都不是好东西，告诉你们，谁敢靠近这个教室，老子马上就杀人。”赵铁柱一阵大骂，旋即又狰狞的大笑道：“臭婊子，既然你这么想救这个学生，好，我现在给你一个机会，让你那个奸夫过来，只要他肯过来当人质，我就放过这个学生。”

远远听到赵铁柱的话，现场所有人的目光都落在了钱大兵的身上。

“我？”一直滞留在现场不曾离开的钱大兵，顿时吓了一跳，下意识的往后退了几步，泡妞可以，但是泡妞泡成人质，随时可能连命都没，那可就是太不划算了，再说，他现在和梅语嫣那是一垒都没上呢。

梅语嫣眼角的余光瞥见钱大兵的动作，露出一抹鄙夷，她大声道：“铁柱哥，到底要怎样，你才肯相信我。”

“我说过了，让那个奸夫过来，我就放了这个学生。”赵铁柱的口气无比强硬。

高队长走过来，拍拍梅语嫣的肩膀，“梅老师，目前赵铁柱情绪激动，你的劝说，恐怕意义不大了。”

说着，他又瞥了瞥那个已经悄悄钻入到人群中，很快溜之不见的钱大兵，不屑的哼了一声道：“至于拿人交换，也是行不通的，我们的目的就是要让劫持犯放弃挟持人质的想法，交换人质根本不是解决问题的办法。”

梅语嫣脸色一黯，苦笑道：“我也没想到事情会发展到这个地步，如果能救那个学生，让我做什么都可以。”

“怎么，没胆过来吗？”过了一会都听不到回话，赵铁柱冷笑着喊道。

“我来吧！”高队长从梅语嫣手里拿过了喇叭说道：“铁柱兄弟，请你不要伤害人质，如果你有什么要求尽管提出来，能满足的我们一定满足。”

“什么狗屁要求，老子不会相信你们这些警察，别他妈想诓我。”教室里，赵铁柱扯着嗓子大喊。

这时，一阵悠扬的铃声从学校四面八方扩散开来。

听到这声音，一直乖乖蹲在地上的秦朗，微微一怔，旋即便意识到这是放学铃声。

他瞄了一眼教室墙壁上挂着的钟，果不其然，上面显示的时间是中午11点30分，正是放学的时间。

“这个点儿应该是吃饭的点儿了。”秦朗琢磨了片刻，目光突然一亮，开口道：“其实你应该提一些要求。”

趴在窗边的赵铁柱猛地回过头来，恶狠狠的瞪着秦朗威胁道：“你他妈还是先管好你自己的小命，再废话，老子就把你舌头割下来。”

秦朗并没有理会赵铁柱的威胁，有条不紊的说道：“你挟持我的目的，无非就是为了和警察对峙。既然如此，为何不趁机提出一些有利于自己的要求？最简单的，如果你想保持旺盛的精力，首要的就是食物。否则，不等警察动手，你自己就先饿晕了。”

在说这些话的时候，秦朗运用了一些声音上的小技巧，语速不快不慢，保持一定的韵律。

这种韵律让人有种信服的感觉，能抚慰情绪。

赵铁柱果然听进去了，甚至忽视了秦朗前后矛盾的表现，自言自语道：“对啊，不吃东西可不行，老子得让这些警察给我送点吃的。”

话音一摞，他肚子好像响应一般，发出了咕咕的叫声。

坐十几个小时的火车，一大早赶到学校见梅语嫣，他也没吃多少东西，肚子早就饿了，只是因为情绪一直激动，忽视了这一点。

赵铁柱揉揉肚子，突然像是想到了什么，脸色一变摇头道：“不行，这些警察不可信，他们一定会在吃的东西里面下毒害我。”

“这一点你完全不用担心，不仅是你饿了，我也饿了，所以警察拿来的食物，我可以先尝试，没有问题你再吃。”秦朗提出了合理的建议。

“有道理。”赵铁柱大为认同，立刻凑到窗边朝外喊道：“你们先给老子送点吃的进来，记住，别他妈跟我玩花样，老子会让人质先吃。”

他之所以提醒赵铁柱，是为了给自己争取时间。

换元呼吸法虽然对施术者本身没有特别要求，但它需要过程。秦朗必须要保证在这个过程进行时，不至于让自己受到赵铁柱的伤害。

警方的动作很快，二十分钟不到的时间，一名穿着学校食堂工作服的年轻女孩儿，便提着一袋饭盒出现在了教室门口。

“大哥，我是来给您送饭的，我可以进来吗？”

赵铁柱透过窗户确认没有其他人跟着，这才点头道：“进来。”

一进门，看到提着刀，衣服上沾染着血渍，满脸狰狞暴虐的赵铁柱，女孩儿似乎吓了一跳，不自觉的往后退了一步，惊慌的举起手中的袋子，“大哥，这是学校食堂给您准备的饭菜，我是食堂员工，警察让我给您送过来的，冤有头债有主，您可千万不要伤害我。”

说这话的时候，女孩儿眼角的余光却在冷静的打量着教室里的情况，和她那慌张的口吻完全不相符。

看到那个被挟持的学生蹲在地上，簌簌发抖的模样，女孩儿不禁微微皱眉，露出不喜之色。

不过女孩儿不知道的是，就在她打量秦朗的时候，秦朗其实也在悄悄地观察着她。

他发现，对方虽然尽力遮掩，但身上散发的气质，与外面的警察极其相似。当然，如果仅仅如此，秦朗也不能断定对方的身份。可偏偏，秦朗看到了女孩儿那食堂员工的工作服里面，露出了一角被刻意遮挡起来的橄榄绿衬衫领子，分明就是警察制服。

得出这样的结论，秦朗实在是有些恼火。这些警察面对一个疯子束手无策也就算了，现在，现在居然派来一个这么蠢的女警，连换装都不知道彻底点。一旦被赵铁柱发现，马上就会暴露身份，并且激怒他。

秦朗在心里将那些狗屁警察骂个半死。

“磨蹭什么呢？赶紧给我拿过来。”闻着饭盒里飘出的香气，赵铁柱的肚子叫的更厉害了，他不耐烦的催促道。

“是，是，大哥，我这就给您拿过来。”女孩儿慌不迭的点头，战战兢兢的朝赵铁柱移了过去，嘴里结结巴巴的说道：“大……大哥，您……您可千万别伤害我。”

在距离赵铁柱只有两米远的时候，，她微微弯腰，作势将袋子放在地上，手却悄悄伸向了里面摆的最高的一个饭盒。

就在这时，一道风声骤然响起，伴随着赵铁柱怒骂声：“臭婊子，老子一眼就看出你是个警察，还他妈跟我装呢。你们这些警察想尽办法要害死我，看老子不砍死你。”

赵铁柱被彻底激怒，理智完全丧失，丝毫不懂怜香惜玉，这一刀居然直接砍向对方的脑袋。

女孩儿浑身一抖，猛一缩脖子，避过脑袋被砍的命运，但几缕青丝却被锋利的刀刃隔断，掉落下来。

女孩儿显然还是第一次应对这样的场面，脸色苍白，呼吸急促，身上颤抖不止，往日里所学的空手夺白刃的技巧，这时候好像忘了似的，只知道手忙脚乱的去摸饭盒。

当手指碰触到饭盒里藏着的枪时，她慌乱的心，才稍稍一定，连忙举枪，对准了赵铁柱。

“糟糕，忘记打开保险了。”女孩儿顾不上责怪自己粗心大意，心慌意乱的连忙去打开保险。

黑洞洞的枪口让赵铁柱呼吸一滞，神情大变。但是枪没有响，这让他有种死里逃生的感觉。而这种感觉，也让他精神病人的本性被激发出来，既然是你死我活，他哪里会给对方再开枪的机会。

瞪着血红的眼睛，赵铁柱疯狂的挥刀砍去，“老子砍死你个臭婊子！老子要把你分尸。”

刀锋直奔女警手腕，已经来不及打开保险了，只能躲避，但最终还是被刀刃割伤了皮肤，猩红的鲜血和白皙的手腕形成鲜明的对比。

女孩儿剧痛之下，惊叫一声，手掌下意识一松，枪掉了下来，整个人朝后退了好几步。

等她回过神来的时候，赵铁柱不知道什么时候已经把枪拣了起来，这一次，黑洞洞的枪口掉转矛头，换做对准她了。

“臭婊子，老子干过民兵，枪这个东西，老子不陌生。你想杀老子，老子先送你上路。”

女孩儿头脑一片空白，吓得紧紧闭上眼，犹如惊弓之鸟。

“换我就不杀她。”就在这时，秦朗突然悠悠的开了口，语调之轻松和当前紧张气氛大相径庭。
content_en:
Zhao Tiezhu retreated into the classroom, with a bit of frightened fear on his ferocious face, and cold sweat on his forehead.

He cautiously looked at the situation outside through the window. When he saw that the police were not approaching and the snipers could no longer target him, he gasped in embarrassment and relaxed.

Feeling the murderer's body behind him trembling slightly, Qin Lang became calmer.A murderer who is afraid of death is much easier to deal with than a desperado.

"Damn, these bullshit police actually want me dead, but I want to live." Zhao Tiezhu muttered to himself a few times, and suddenly patted Qin Lang on the head with a knife, "Boy, squat down, if you dare to move, I will bleed you immediately."

Qin Lang felt happy that the other party was willing to let go of his hold on him, which was a good thing for him.

So he nodded immediately. After the other party let go of his arm, he immediately squatted down without any resistance.

If Zhao Tiezhu had observed carefully at this time, he would have discovered that Qin Lang, who had been in a semi-suffocated state, did not take a big breath after his neck was freed. Instead, he always maintained an unchanging breathing pattern, with his abdomen slightly expanding and contracting.

It's a pity that Zhao Tiezhu couldn't see this.Qin Lang's obedience became cowardice and cowardice in his eyes, while the swelling and contraction of Qin Lang's abdomen became trembling fear in his eyes.

A weak and timid high school student was not enough to pose any threat at all, so why should Zhao Tiezhu be worried.

He held the blood-stained knife and walked around anxiously. From time to time he would go to the window and look outside, and then he would curse, sometimes at the police, sometimes at Mei Yuyan.

"Brother Tiezhu, I really have no intention of harming you. Just treat it like I'm begging you. Can you let that student go? Or, I'll replace that student and I'll be your hostage!" Mei Yuyan's voice amplified through the speaker suddenly came from outside the window.

"Fart, stinky bitch, you and the police are not good friends. Let me tell you, I will kill anyone who dares to come near this classroom." Zhao Tiezhu cursed for a while, and then laughed ferociously: "Stinky bitch, since you want to save this student so much, okay, I will give you a chance now to let your adulterer come over. As long as he is willing to come over and be a hostage, I will let this student go."

Hearing Zhao Tiezhu's words from afar, everyone's eyes fell on Qian Dabing.

"Me?" Qian Dabing, who had been staying at the scene and never left, was immediately startled and subconsciously took a few steps back. It's okay to pick up girls, but if you pick up girls and become hostages, you may lose your life at any time. That's not worth it. Besides, he and Mei Yuyan haven't reached first base yet.

Mei Yuyan caught a glimpse of Qian Dabing's actions from the corner of her eye, showing a hint of disdain. She said loudly: "Brother Tiezhu, what will it take for you to believe me?"

"I said, let the adulterer come over and I will let the student go." Zhao Tiezhu's tone was extremely tough.

Captain Gao came over and patted Mei Yuyan on the shoulder, "Teacher Mei, Zhao Tiezhu is currently very emotional. I'm afraid your persuasion won't mean much."

As he said that, he glanced at the soldier Qian who had quietly slipped into the crowd and quickly disappeared. He snorted disdainfully and said: "As for exchanging people, it won't work. Our purpose is to make the hijackers give up the idea of taking hostages. Exchanging hostages is not a solution to the problem at all."

Mei Yuyan's face darkened and she smiled bitterly: "I didn't expect things to develop to this point. If I can save that student, I can do anything."

"Why, don't you have the guts to come here?" After a while, no reply was heard, and Zhao Tiezhu shouted with a sneer.

"I'll do it!" Captain Gao took the horn from Mei Yuyan's hand and said, "Brother Tiezhu, please don't hurt the hostages. If you have any demands, just ask them. We will satisfy them if they can be met."

"What bullshit demands, I won't believe you policemen, don't fucking try to trick me." Zhao Tiezhu shouted at the top of his lungs in the classroom.

At this time, a melodious ringing of bells spread from all directions in the school.

Hearing this sound, Qin Lang, who had been squatting on the ground obediently, was slightly startled, and soon realized that it was the school bell.

He glanced at the clock hanging on the wall of the classroom, and sure enough, the time displayed on it was 11:30 noon, which was the time for school to end.

"This should be the time to eat." Qin Lang thought for a moment, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he said, "Actually, you should make some requests."

Zhao Tiezhu, who was lying by the window, suddenly turned around, glared at Qin Lang and threatened: "You should take care of your own life first, if you talk nonsense, I will cut out your tongue."

Qin Lang ignored Zhao Tiezhu's threat and said methodically: "The purpose of your holding me hostage is to confront the police. In this case, why not take the opportunity to make some demands that are beneficial to yourself? The simplest thing is that if you want to maintain strong energy, the first thing is food. Otherwise, you will faint from hunger before the police take action."

When speaking these words, Qin Lang used some small vocal techniques, speaking neither too fast nor too slow, and maintaining a certain rhythm.

This rhythm gives people a convincing feeling and can soothe emotions.

Zhao Tiezhu really listened, and even ignored Qin Lang's inconsistent performance, and said to himself: "Yes, it's not okay if I don't eat. I have to ask these policemen to give me some food."

As soon as he finished speaking, his stomach seemed to respond and made a growling sound.

After taking a train for more than ten hours, he rushed to school early in the morning to meet Mei Yuyan. He didn't eat much and was already hungry. He just ignored it because he was always excited.

Zhao Tiezhu rubbed his stomach and suddenly thought of something. His face changed and he shook his head and said, "No, these police officers can't be trusted. They will definitely poison me in the food I eat."

"You don't have to worry about this at all. Not only are you hungry, but I am also hungry, so I can try the food brought by the police first. If there is no problem, you can eat it." Qin Lang made reasonable suggestions.

"It makes sense." Zhao Tiezhu agreed greatly, and immediately went to the window and shouted outside: "You guys bring me some food first. Remember, don't play tricks on me, I will let the hostages eat first."

The reason why he reminded Zhao Tiezhu was to buy himself time.

Although the Changing Breathing Method has no special requirements for the practitioner, it does require a process.Qin Lang must ensure that he will not be harmed by Zhao Tiezhu during this process.

The police acted quickly. In less than twenty minutes, a young girl wearing school cafeteria work clothes appeared at the door of the classroom carrying a bag of lunch boxes.

"Brother, I'm here to deliver food to you, can I come in?"

Zhao Tiezhu checked through the window that no one else was following, then nodded and said: "Come in."

As soon as she entered the door, she saw Zhao Tiezhu who was holding a knife, blood stains on his clothes, and a ferocious look on his face. The girl seemed startled, and unconsciously took a step back. She raised the bag in her hand in panic, "Brother, this is the meal prepared for you by the school cafeteria. I am a cafeteria employee, and the police asked me to deliver it to you. Every wrongdoer has his own debtor, so please don't hurt me."

When she said this, the girl was calmly observing the situation in the classroom from the corner of her eye, which was completely inconsistent with her panic tone.

Seeing the kidnapped student squatting on the ground, trembling, the girl couldn't help but frown slightly, showing an unhappy look.

But what the girl didn't know was that when she was looking at Qin Lang, Qin Lang was also quietly observing her.

He found that although the other party tried his best to hide it, the aura he exuded was very similar to that of the police outside.Of course, if that's all, Qin Lang can't determine the identity of the other party.However, Qin Lang saw the girl's canteen employee's work clothes, revealing a corner of the olive green shirt collar that was deliberately covered up. It was clearly a police uniform.

Coming to such a conclusion, Qin Lang was really annoyed.It's okay for these police officers to be helpless in the face of a madman. Now, now, they have sent such a stupid policewoman who doesn't even know how to change her clothes thoroughly.Once discovered by Zhao Tiezhu, his identity will be exposed immediately and anger him.

Qin Lang cursed those bullshit police officers half to death in his heart.

"What are you waiting for? Bring it to me quickly." Smelling the aroma wafting from the lunch box, Zhao Tiezhu's stomach growled even more, and he urged impatiently.

"Yes, yes, brother, I will get it for you right now." The girl nodded in panic, moved toward Zhao Tiezhu tremblingly, and stammered: "Brother...brother, you...don't hurt me."

When she was only two meters away from Zhao Tiezhu, she bent down slightly and placed the bag on the ground, but quietly reached out to the tallest lunch box inside.

At this moment, a gust of wind suddenly sounded, accompanied by Zhao Tiezhu's angry curse: "Bitch, I can tell at a glance that you are a policeman, and you are still pretending to be with me. You policemen are trying your best to kill me, let's see if I don't chop you to death."

Zhao Tiezhu was completely angered, completely lost his mind, and had no sense of mercy. This knife actually struck the opponent's head directly.

The girl trembled all over and shrank her neck to avoid having her head chopped off, but a few strands of black hair were cut off by the sharp blade and fell down.

It was obviously the first time for the girl to face such a scene. Her face was pale, her breathing was rapid, and her body was shaking. She seemed to have forgotten the skills she had learned in the past about grabbing a sword with bare hands, and she only knew how to touch the lunch box in a hurry.

When her fingers touched the gun hidden in the lunch box, her panicked heart finally calmed down, and she quickly raised the gun and pointed it at Zhao Tiezhu.

"Oops, I forgot to turn on the insurance." The girl didn't bother to blame herself for being careless, and hurriedly opened the insurance in a panic.

The black muzzle of the gun made Zhao Tiezhu's breath stagnate and his expression changed drastically.But the gun didn't go off, which made him feel like he had a narrow escape.And this feeling also aroused his mental patient nature. Since it was life and death, how could he give the other party a chance to shoot again.

Staring with blood-red eyes, Zhao Tiezhu slashed wildly with his knife, "I'll chop you to death, you stinking bitch! I'll cut you into pieces."

The blade went straight towards the policewoman's wrist. It was too late to open the safety guard, so she could only dodge, but in the end the skin was cut by the blade. The scarlet blood was in sharp contrast with the white wrist.

The girl screamed in severe pain, her palms subconsciously loosened, the gun fell, and she took several steps back.

When she came to her senses, Zhao Tiezhu had picked up the gun at some point. This time, the black muzzle of the gun turned around and was pointed at her.

"Smelly bitch, I have served in the militia, and I am no stranger to guns. If you want to kill me, I will send you on your way first."

The girl's mind went blank and she closed her eyes tightly in fear, like a frightened bird.

"I wouldn't have killed her." At this moment, Qin Lang suddenly spoke leisurely, his tone of voice very different from the current tense atmosphere.
